eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED WEEKLY TEST for the following counties or areas: Holmes, OH; at 11:28 AM on AUG 14, 2018 Effective until 12:28 PM. Message from OHIOSTEM.
extra_text: This is a test of the Ohio emergency alert system  originating from the state emergency operations center in Columbus.  This is only a test.  Had this been an actual emergency you would have received further instructions on this and other participating stations in your area.  This concludes this test of the Ohio emergency alert system. No action is needed. This is only a test.
